name: Beryl
bio: Archetype: Lingering Glow, Empower Incantation, Extra Action. ⌽ [Lingering Glow] stacks accumulate when [Burn] or [Halo] is inflicted, increasing team Crit Rate and enabling a FUA to be cast. ⌽ Gains a precast [Emanation] at each turn start based on the color of crystals chosen when entering battle. Gains Moxie at turn end if a certain amount of [Lingering Glow] is reached. ⌽ Blue: Extra Actions inflict [Halo]. [Emanation] increases FUA cast rate. All FUA gain a reuse chance. ⌽ Red: Active Actions inflict [Halo]. [Emanation] decreases [Lingering Glow] required for a FUA to be cast, and increases its Crit Rate scaling. ⌽ Green: High-tier skills inflict [Halo]. [Emanation] ranks up AP space. FUA is considered high-tier. ⌽ Ultimate redistributes [Halo] on enemies based on their HP. This is considered [Halo] re-infliction.
